The user wants to arrange a flight for booking ID 1234 as soon as possible, check different options, calculate from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class ticket price. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport code, travel_to last airport code, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight for booking ID 1234. We might need to cancel existing booking? Or just book new flight? The user says "I need to arrange a flight on booking number 1234 as soon as possible". That implies maybe they want to change booking? But we don't have a function to modify booking. We can cancel booking 1234 and then book new flight. But the user didn't mention cancellation. They want to check different options. So maybe we just compute cost. Provide estimated total payable amount. But we need to know credit card? For booking, we need card_id. But we don't have card id. We could get all credit cards. Then choose one. But the user didn't ask to actually book. They just want to compute cost. So we can call get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to consider insurance? Not mentioned. So just cost.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost. Then output cost. But we need to provide estimated total payable amount. That is the cost. So we can do that.

We need to call get_all_airports. Then parse result. Then call get_flight_cost. Then output. Let's do that.
